text: We are what we pretend to be, so we must be careful about what we pretend to be.
author: Kurt Vonnegut
visual_brief: A precise architectural section and elevation of a theatrical false front, showing a hollow decorative facade supported by timber scaffolding, with detailed engineering callouts revealing that the ornamental exterior has developed massive concrete footings and structural piles driven deep into the bedrock.
alt: Architectural cross-section of a hollow facade anchored permanently into bedrock
